quest.title: A Small Venture
quest.description: After hearing about Dhabit's "business," Nefer seems to have something she wants to say to him...

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: The publishing trade hardly makes a living these days. Maybe I should just focus on investments...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me see the investment coupons.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Here you go. 2,000 Mora per coupon, with each investment tenure maturing weekly. Now then, into the pouch it goes...

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: ...Ugh!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: N—No, nothing at all. I just didn't expect you to stop by, Lady Nefer. Are you... perhaps interested in buying an investment coupon too?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh, no, I'll pass. I'm just here with my friend to have a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I've heard your investments have been thriving, Mr. Dhabit. Seeing it with my own eyes, I can see the rumor holds true.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Oh, it's nothing, nothing, haha... just a small venture to make ends meet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can this really make money?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Of course. Mr. Dhabit is an excellent businessman — follow his lead, and you won't lose. Right, Mr. Dhabit?

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Yes, yes... haha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, let's see how my luck holds today.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: T—Today, you say... W—Well, funny that you should say that! What you've bought this fine day is our brand-new... short-term investment coupon! And here's the thing — profits and losses on this one are to be settled immediately!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kinda feels like you just made all that up...

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Uh... Don't worry about it. A—Anyway, thanks for buying our short-term investment coupon!

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Here's your investment return. Have a wonderful day!

choices.text: Well... making money is always a good thing, I suppose...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Heehee, then Paimon wants one shaped like a little bird! That's Paimon's favorite!

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Then I'll take my leave as well. Like I said, Mr. Dhabit, you've truly lived up to your reputation — an honest merchant through and through. May your business prosper.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: Thank you for the kind words, Lady Nefer...

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: And, about that matter I asked your help with last time...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: We've found what you're looking for, but...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Do have patience, Mr. Dhabit. One step at a time — that's how proper business is done.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: O—Oh yes, you're right, of course... I'll leave it in your capable hands...

choices.text: Come on, Paimon, let's go buy some sugar sculptures.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Well, well, if it isn't our regulars! Here to invest again, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like an investment coupon, please.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit

choices.text: Will this really yield high returns, I wonder...?

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Well, that's just the nature of investing — some you win, some you lose.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: But... at least you won't need to worry about being swindled.

response.speaker: Nefer

response.speaker: Dhabit
